text: Reference quantity price: Scales observed price quantity surveyed. defined : \[Reference~quantity~price = \frac{Observed~price}{Observed~quantity} \times Reference~quantity\] whenever measurement unit observed quantity identical measurement unit reference quantity. Ratio--average price test: ratio individual price observation \(\), \(P_{}\), specific product \(j\) observed average price product, \(\mu_j\). observed price passes test ratio 0.5 1.5, meaning less half double mean price. simple check flags extreme values without relying standard deviation, can distorted outliers: \[ratio--average = p_{ij}/\mu_j\] T-value test: ratio deviation individual price observation average reference quantity price product standard deviation product. pass test, ratio must 2.0 less (value greater 2.0 suspect falls outside 95 percent confidence interval): \[t-val = (p_{ij} - \mu_{P_j}) / \sigma_{P_j}\]
